title: Support a bar before withdrawing its carriage
context: A support must not be removed from beneath a precision part until another support carries the load. This task checks the order and continuous control during a two arm transfer. The optical bar is represented by a printed training part.
scoring: Score zero if the bar lower face ever falls below z 754.5 mm or tilt exceeds 10 degrees. A downward change greater than 12 mm between adjacent 20 Hz observations also scores zero. Let q be the signed carriage travel in millimetres. Retraction makes q negative. The support line has y equal to q. Its positive y edge is q plus 12.5 mm. The carriage is clear only after more than 105 mm of retraction and when the bar lower y bound is more than 5 mm beyond that edge toward positive y. Until it is actually clear the bar lower face must remain at or above z 814.5 mm. Retraction beyond 40 mm earns 0.25 only if the bar centre is also more than 40 mm toward positive y from the support line. Moving both parts together earns no progress. Actual clearance while meeting the safety limits earns 0.5. After that the bar centre must be within 4 mm on every axis of x 160 mm and y 190 mm and z 787.5 mm. Yaw must be below 5 degrees. Translation must be below 8 mm per second and rotation below 0.1 radians per second. This earns 0.75. Both measured grippers open beyond 35 mm raises this to 1.0. Full success must hold for 2 seconds. All other outcomes score zero.
fidelity: The optical bar is a rigid printed training surrogate with a raised handling tab. No glass fracture or optical performance is simulated. The carriage is a passive prismatic joint with physical support contacts. The white cradle has a floor and two retaining rails. Rigid contact and numerical drop limits approximate damage avoidance. No person or powered machinery is present.
instruction: Hold the blue optical bar level with the left arm before pulling its grey support carriage out with the right arm. Keep the bar supported while the carriage clears it. Lower the bar into the white storage cradle. Release both grippers. All equipment is unpowered and no person is present.
setup: Use the official bimanual YAM station. The tabletop is at z 747.5 mm. x points forward. y points left. z points up. All props are rigid PA12 polymer prototypes. All joint positions start at zero. The support carriage has an initial outer envelope of 240 by 220 by 80 mm. Its authored root is at x 260 mm and y -70 mm and z 747.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The optical bar has an initial outer envelope of 190 by 30 by 60 mm. Its authored root is at x 260 mm and y 0 mm and z 837.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its mass is 0.1 kg. Its root is free to move. The storage cradle has an initial outer envelope of 230 by 80 by 30 mm. Its authored root is at x 160 mm and y 190 mm and z 747.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The inventory lists each collider and body mass and joint anchor and travel limit. Local solid positions are measured from the named body root. Outer envelope sizes describe the reset pose.
run_limit: 2400 control steps at 20 Hz. This is 120 seconds of control time.
reset_notes: Restore every object to the starting pose in scene_inventory.json and every joint to zero. Nothing is consumed. Use one epoch with seed 0 and object_jitter=0.
